purpose: shell script static analysis (ShellCheck), offline, JSON (json1) output; the shell lane of 02-source-sast.
notes: shellcheck-py 0.11.0.1 is the PyPI wheel of the upstream ShellCheck 0.11.0 static binary; `shellcheck --version` prints the upstream version, so version_expect names it literally and changes with a version bump. --norc keeps a target's .shellcheckrc from changing the analysis. Exit 1 means comments were reported.
